is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles funestus (s.s.) populations.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The paper reports genotyping of the VGSC gene (specifically the 1014 codon) in Anopheles funestus.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper states that 10 field-collected female mosquitoes were sequenced and that 'Neither the L1014F kdr mutation nor the L1014S mutation was detected' and 'the VGSC gene sequencing analysis detected only the TTA 1014 codon'.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in Gankette Balla, Senegal.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical study reporting new field collections and molecular analysis.

sub_country_location.evidence: The study location is Gankette Balla, northern Senegal.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new collection and analysis of Anopheles funestus from Gankette Balla, Senegal.

supplement.evidence: The necessary data regarding the absence of kdr mutations is provided in the main text.

assessment.summary: This study investigated insecticide resistance in Anopheles funestus from Gankette Balla, Senegal. Bioassays showed resistance to pyrethroids and DDT. Molecular analysis of the VGSC gene in 10 field-collected females confirmed the absence of L1014F and L1014S kdr mutations.
